fields.value: Dataset accompanying Holopainen, Verhage, Schuengel, Tharner, & Oosterman

dsDescriptionValue.value:
This datafile holds the data used in Holopainen, Verhage, Schuengel, Tharner & Oosterman, "Mothers’ chronic parenting stress, social support and parental burnout 
during the pandemic".

keywordValue.value: parenting stress, parental burnout, social support, COVID-19, longitudinal study

fields.value: This project has been preregistered (osf.io/kz8q4), but there is not yet a published article presenting the results.

value: Survey data including longitudinal data on  demographic variables, parenting stress, parental burnout and social support

files.description:
The dataset is a csv file that uses ";" as a separator and "," for decimals.

There are 1787 cases and 32 variables in the dataset. A list and description of the variables (presented in 12 clusters):

1. genderchild (0 = boy, 1 = girl)

2. educationmother (1 = primary education, 2 = secondary education, 3 = tertiary education)

3. singleT1 / T7 / T8 / COV (marital status at different time points, 0 = with partner, 1 = single)

4. eversingleWITHCOV / WITHOUTCOV (an index variable whether one has ever been single with data during the COVID-19 pandemic / without data from the covid pandemic, 0 = never single, 1 = single at least at one time point)

5. hea4 / 6 / 7 / 8 (Parenting stress dimension "health" at different time points, see more information on the preregistration)

6. par4 / 6 / 7 / 8 (Parenting stress dimension "parenting" at different time points, see more information on the preregistration)

7. soc4 / 6 / 7 / 8 (Parenting stress dimension "social" at different time points, see more information on the preregistration)

8. PSI4SUM / PSI6SUM / PSI7SUM / PSI8SUM (Sum scores of the total score for Parenting Stress Index at different time points)

9. pb1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 (Six parental burnout items, see more information on the preregistration)

10. pb (mean score of the six parental burnout items)

11. spar (support from one's partner, see more information on the preregistration)

12. snet (support from one's social network, see more information on the preregistration)
